invariants.description: symmetric carrier: J = open_flag V_max (C_up/(K_m + C_up) - C_down/(K_m + C_down)), J_down = J, J_up = -J (mass conserved across the membrane) (exact)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(J, open_flag*V_max*(C_up/(K_m + C_up) - C_down/(K_m + C_down)), rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.array_equal(J_down, J) and np.array_equal(J_up, -J)

invariants.description: second law: facilitated transport runs down its gradient, J ln(C_up/C_down) >= 0
